components.name: Evidence table
components.css: .ds-table{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--surface-border);border-radius:8px;border-spacing:0;background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);font-size:0.75rem;text-align:left}.ds-table caption{padding:12px 16px;color:var(--text-secondary);text-align:left}.ds-table th,.ds-table td{padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--surface-border)}.ds-table th{background:var(--surface-subtle)}

narrative.overview: This records the built inspection feature, not a replacement product identity.
keyCharacteristics: Compact operational tables with progressive evidence disclosure.
Existing page frame, controls, navigation and bilingual copy.
Textual execution and evidence states that remain readable independently of color.
dos: Do reuse shared tokens and the established shell.
Do keep state labels readable and expose secondary evidence on narrow screens.
Do distinguish stored historical evidence from the current source page.
donts: Don't introduce local colors, fonts or an alternative page frame.
Don't imply that an unknown result passed, or that report refresh repeats collection.
